in_sanskrit.name: कुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ku meaning 'small' or 'younger', ma meaning 'mother' and ra meaning 'man'. Thus, Kumara is a name that signifies 'younger brother', 'son', or 'prince'. It is also a name given to certain gods, particularly Skanda, Murugan, and Subrahmanya, who are considered the gods of war and healing.

in_marathi.name: Kumara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kumara is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kumara' which means 'Little Lord'. In Hindu mythology, Kumara is the name of various gods and heroes, including the son of Shiva and Parvati, and the god of war, Kartikeya.
